brief: A creative/interactive experience: a 3D or motion-led page that stays fast and accessible, with a DOM-equivalent and reduced-motion fallback, resource cleanup, and no keyboard/focus breakage.

functional.accept: tsc/build pass; required features present in the browser check; domain-deps/state-audit no confirmed
functional.reject: does not compile OR a required feature missing OR a confirmed boundary/state defect

accessibility.accept: ui-audit no confirmed; axe no violation; keyboard reachable; reflow@320 and text-scale@200 hold

performance.accept: bundle within budget; route-attribution plausible; perf-audit no confirmed
performance.reject: a budget breach under a compatible profile
performance.note: built/route-associated bytes only; lab not field

visual.e0a_accept: design-consistency no confirmed literal-vs-token; reduced-motion honored; the five data-view states present where applicable
visual.e2: HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED: hierarchy, composition, density, identity, motion taste judged from the capture set; never auto-passed

rubric: does the effect explain or just impress
is content readable over the canvas
does the reduced-motion path stay usable
does it feel crafted, not gratuitous
human_review.note: E2 human judgement over the capture set; no automated signal produces a visual PASS
